legacy_findings_preserved.description: SessionStore::is_persistent() returns true for open/try_open and false for in_memory. Unit-tested in 3 new tests in crates/chronos-store/src/storage.rs.
ChronosServer::is_degraded() returns true for an in-memory test store and false for a persistent store. Unit-tested in 1 new test in crates/chronos-mcp/src/server.rs.

session_envelope(degraded, value) helper preserves the existing JSON object shape and adds a single top-level `degraded` key. Defensive fallback wraps non-object values into {result, degraded} so the wire contract stays an object.
legacy_findings_preserved.mitigation: Verified with 2 unit tests (object injection + non-object wrap).

legacy_findings_preserved.description: Real-tool envelope assertions: list_sessions and save_session both include `degraded: true` at the top level when the server is built from an in-memory store, and the existing fields (session_count, sessions, session_id, status, etc.) are preserved unchanged.
legacy_findings_preserved.mitigation: Verified with 2 round-trip tests that decode the JSON content and assert on the parsed shape.

legacy_findings_preserved.description: T0 + clippy clean on the workspace head. cargo fmt --all applied; no drift.

T4-smoke (chronos-sandbox subset) green: e2e_connectivity 1/0, session_persistence 4/0, session_lifecycle 8/0 = 13/0. CHRONOS_MCP_PATH set to the rebuilt binary so the stale-binary symptom flagged in AGENTS.md §1 cannot mask regressions.

Spec correction: the proposal and earlier spec draft named the session-persistence tools with underscores-as-separators (session_save/session_list/session_load). The actual MCP tool names registered in server.rs are save_session, list_sessions, load_session, delete_session, drop_session. Spec REQ-M9-82-03 and the proposal scope/acceptance bullets were amended mid-cycle with a note documenting the correction.
legacy_findings_preserved.mitigation: Spec and proposal amended; the contract now applies to all five tools symmetrically.
